gp.message:
================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO YE AFTER EFFECTS - ZVITSVA
Vhezheni 9.2.9  -  Gumiguru 2026
================================================================================

MATHEME EANIME matsva 33 abatana neeDemon Slayer, maeffect emouse ematheme ava
kuoneka chaizvo mukati meAfter Effects, uye Kusarudza Theme kwave dropdown imwe
chete yakarongeka.

USATI WATANGA
- Isa pamusoro pevhezheni yaunayo ikozvino uchishandisa ZXP installer yako
  yenguva dzose, wobva wavhura After Effects zvakare kamwe chete.
- Marongero ako, theme, ma-preset nema-expression awakachengeta zvose
  zvinochengetedzwa.

ZVITSVA: MATHEME EANIME 33
- Flex Marongero > KUSARUDZA THEME > THEME YEPANEL ikozvino ine boka rimwe chete
  reanime yega yega:
  Attack on Titan (Levi), Berserk (Guts), Black Clover (Asta),
  Bleach (Ichigo, Hitsugaya), Chainsaw Man (Denji, Reze), Code Geass (Lelouch),
  Dandadan (Okarun), Death Note (Kira), Dragon Ball (Goku), Frieren,
  Fullmetal Alchemist (Edward), Hunter x Hunter (Killua, Kurapika, Hisoka),
  Jujutsu Kaisen (Gojo, Sukuna), KonoSuba (Megumin), Mob Psycho 100 (Mob),
  My Hero Academia (Bakugo, Deku, Todoroki), Naruto (Itachi, Minato),
  One Piece (Luffy, Zoro, Law), One-Punch Man (Saitama), Re:Zero (Rem),
  Solo Leveling (Jinwoo), Spy x Family (Anya) naTokyo Ghoul (Kaneki).
- Munhu wega wega ane chitarisiko chake: chinotevera mouse yako, kurwisa kana
  wadzvanya bhatani, zvinoitika paunenge wakabata bhatani rekuruboshwe, uye
  kuputika mushure mekubata kwemasekonzi anenge 2.5.
- Akareruka sematheme eDemon Slayer: maeffect anongoshanda kana uchifambisa
  mouse kana kudzvanya. Dzima MAEFFECT ANOTENDEREDZA kuti uchengete mavara
  chete.

SHANDURO: KUSARUDZA THEME
- Makadhi eDemon Slayer pasi peTHEME YEPANEL abviswa, saka Flex Marongero yava
  pfupi. Sarudza theme yega yega kubva padropdown yeTHEME YEPANEL; inovhurika
  patheme yauri kushandisa.
- Kurama naBaryon ikozvino vari muboka reNaruto.

ZVAKAGADZIRISWA
- Maeffect emouse ematheme (mvura, murazvo, mheni nezvimwe) kazhinji aisaoneka
  mukati meAfter Effects, kunyange Optimised Mode yakadzimwa. Nguva dzaibatikana
  panel pachayo, uye kutanga kwakaremera, zvaitorwa sekunonoka kwetheme, saka
  maeffect aizvidzima ega. Ikozvino, kana graphics card yako ichiadhirowa
  (makomputa mazhinji), nguva idzodzo dzinongoita kuti maeffect arerukirwe
  kwechinguva.

ZVISINA KUSHANDURWA
- Rezinesi, activation uye lingi rega rega zvinoshanda zvakafanana nepakutanga.
- Matheme 11 eDemon Slayer anotaridzika zvakafanana nemuvhezheni 9.2.8.
- Tabhu imwe neimwe yasara nechishandiso chega chega zvinoshanda zvakafanana
  nemuvhezheni 9.2.8.
================================================================================
